knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic claims and policy snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled fictional claims, policy terms, loss facts, documents, notes, fraud scores, amounts, statuses, and dates support repeatable demos.

knowledge.name: Claims controls and review rules
knowledge.detail: Packaged guidance separates claim facts, policy evidence, heuristic indicators, nonbinding estimates, human decisions, and external actions.

knowledge.name: Operation skills and locked evidence anchors
knowledge.detail: Four skills define natural-language routing, source-backed procedures, required synthetic evidence, safety statements, and review gates.

intelligence_processing.name: Claims intake triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes the fictional queue by claim, loss, amount, status, and fraud-review score to identify files needing specialized handling.

intelligence_processing.name: Claim-file readiness analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Combines policy terms, loss evidence, supporting documents, and adjuster notes to surface missing material for adjudicator review.

intelligence_processing.name: Explainable SIU indicator review
intelligence_processing.detail: Applies fixed thresholds to surface fraud indicators and candidate SIU referrals while explicitly stating that a score does not prove fraud.

intelligence_processing.name: Policy-term settlement estimation
intelligence_processing.detail: Produces nonbinding policy-limit and deductible estimates; it never determines coverage or autonomously approves, denies, settles, or pays.

intelligence_processing.name: Evidence-first request routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps adjuster, claims-manager, SIU, and operations-leader language to one bounded operation and its matching synthetic evidence.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language claims preparation through a validated Draft agent with four skills and two synthetic knowledge files.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file RAPP agent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with deterministic synthetic-only operation routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Role-based claims review experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Claims adjusters, adjudicators, managers, SIU investigators, and operations leaders receive evidence-first outputs with review gates.

management_reporting.name: Claims intake dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports fictional claim counts, total claimed value, status distribution, loss context, assigned adjuster, and fraud-review scores.

management_reporting.name: Adjudication readiness report
management_reporting.detail: Presents claim and policy details, available documents, missing evidence, and adjuster notes for authorized adjudicator review.

management_reporting.name: SIU indicator and referral report
management_reporting.detail: Lists weighted indicator definitions, threshold-crossing claims, and candidate SIU referrals without declaring fraud or changing coverage.

management_reporting.name: Settlement estimate review
management_reporting.detail: Shows claimed amounts, deductibles, fraud scores, and nonbinding estimates while confirming no approval, settlement, or payment occurred.

tools.name: Portable ClaimsProcessingAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements four read-only operations over bundled synthetic claims and policy evidence.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable tool and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the Draft conversational package, synthetic knowledge, and four operation skills; publication requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 claims case data
tools.detail: Approved production connection seam for claims context; it is not connected to the current fixed synthetic package.

tools.name: Policy-administration system
tools.detail: Approved production seam for policy terms and coverage evidence; current calculations use only bundled fictional terms.

tools.name: SharePoint or approved claims repository
tools.detail: Approved document-evidence seam for production use; the packaged agent uses uploaded synthetic knowledge files instead.

tools.name: SIU case workflow
tools.detail: Approved seam for investigator review and referral handling; the agent only identifies review candidates and never opens or closes cases.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams adjuster approvals
tools.detail: Approved collaboration seam for human decisions; the package does not send messages, request approvals, or execute claim actions.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence policy
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional records and forbids browsing, enrichment, substitution, or invention of missing claim and policy facts.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes claim intake, adjudication review, fraud flagging, and settlement-estimate requests from persona-language prompts.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed record handling
supporting_features.detail: Rejects unknown claim identifiers instead of silently substituting another record or fabricating supporting evidence.

supporting_features.name: Fraud-score interpretation boundary
supporting_features.detail: Treats fraud scores as explainable review indicators only and preserves SIU authority to investigate and determine findings.

supporting_features.name: Authorized adjudicator review gate
supporting_features.detail: Requires adjuster or claims adjudicator review plus SIU, legal, compliance, coverage, and payment authority where applicable.

supporting_features.name: No autonomous settlement or side effects
supporting_features.detail: Prevents approval, denial, reserving, settlement, payment, claimant outreach, referrals, communications, and claim or policy record changes.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four persona cases verify deterministic evidence and safety boundaries; Copilot Studio stays Draft until publish is separately approved.
